prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new HAVENLINE World 1 upgrade-design proposal sheet, using the supplied selected base image(s) as immutable design-family references. Premium chunky rounded stylized 3D mobile-game art, warm orange timber, navy/blue painted metal, rounded steel brackets, light sculpted snow, clean navy studio background. Two authored appearance proposals, NOT numeric equipment levels and NOT unlocks: top row REINFORCED; bottom row ADVANCED. Exact 2-row by 3-column board. Each row depicts the SAME object consistently in front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, and close functional side/detail view. Six clear roomy panels, identical design features across that row, neutral studio lighting. Header HAVENLINE / WORLD 1 / COOKER PROCESSOR. Small subtitle APPEARANCE STUDY. Short labels only. No level numbers, costs, stats, new recipes, characters, HUD, watermarks, decorative clutter, giant growth, or giant resource models. Upgrades must be visually meaningful through engineered reinforcements and material improvements, remain recognizably the selected original, and retain compact footprint, input/output positions, service clearances and underlying purpose. These are authored concept designs, not observed reference-video claims. Do not redraw the retained base as an extra tier.
Keep the selected square navy-blue riveted cooker, orange timber posts, snow-covered top, single centered chimney, front firebox door with orange handle and distinct side pressure vessel. In the front view raw intake is physically LEFT, cooked output physically RIGHT. Never reverse these physical ports when rotating the model. Reference2 supplies existing compact belt docking heights/widths and product scale; include only short matching inlet/outlet lips, not long belts or people. Top row reinforced: thicker protective corner straps, better door seal, riveted plinth, single chimney. Bottom row advanced: stronger blue insulated panels, clean orange reinforcing frame, improved visible pressure piping/heat shield within same footprint; still one cooker, one centered chimney, one original front door, same left/right ports. Rear must have consistent service access and pipe connections, no invented output port. Close functional view should make a raw intake on one end and separate cooked-output interface unmistakable. No extra recipe or extra product type. This is the food cooker, NOT the warming furnace or iron smelter.
